scripts.full-check: turbo lint build test integration-test lint-styles lint-json check-assets --force
scripts.ts-check: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter "!oxytype" ts-check
scripts.lint: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter "!oxytype" lint
scripts.lint-be: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/backend lint
scripts.lint-fe: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend lint
scripts.lint-pkg: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter "./packages/*" lint
scripts.lint-fix: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter "!oxytype" lint --fix
scripts.lint-fast: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter "!oxytype" lint-fast
scripts.lint-fast-be: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/backend lint-fast
scripts.lint-fast-fe: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend lint-fast
scripts.lint-fast-pkg: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter "./packages/*" lint-fast
scripts.build: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend --filter @oxytype/backend build
scripts.build-be: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/backend build
scripts.build-fe: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend build
scripts.test: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter "!oxytype" test && vp run --filter "!oxytype" integration-test
scripts.test-be: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/backend test && vp run --filter @oxytype/backend integration-test
scripts.test-fe: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend test
scripts.test-pkg: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter "./packages/*" test
scripts.dev: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter "!oxytype" --parallel dev
scripts.dev-be: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/backend dev
scripts.dev-fe: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend dev
scripts.dev-pkg: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter "./packages/*" --parallel dev
scripts.storybook: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend storybook
scripts.start: vp run build && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend --filter @oxytype/backend --parallel start
scripts.start-be: vp run build-be && vp run --filter @oxytype/backend start
scripts.start-fe: vp run build-fe && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend start
scripts.check-assets: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend check-assets
scripts.check-assets-quotes: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend check-assets quotes
scripts.check-assets-languages: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend check-assets languages
scripts.check-assets-others: vp run build-pkg && vp run --filter @oxytype/frontend check-assets others
